The pole is adorned with colorful ribbons (streamers) extending from the top down to a lower structure or ground level. A decorative wreath of flowers and greenery encircles the middle section of the pole. Below the wreath, there appears to be a small roofed structure or platform. People are visible at the bottom edge of the frame, observing or participating. The lighting suggests daytime with some overexposure in the sky.
